combo_label: Around the House × Sewing & Knitting × Alice in Wonderland

entries.clue: Chill moisture creeping through old walls, bringing mould with it
Shaggy head on a stick, swished over tiles after a spill
Four in the afternoon, when broiling for dinner begins, says Humpty Dumpty
Seasoning the cook adds so freely that the baby sneezes without pause
Paper template of shapes to be pinned down, cut round and followed
Fold pressed into a fabric to give fullness, as down a school skirt
Two- or three-seater with an arm at each end, sagging in the middle
Cut shapes of cloth laid on a background and secured all round the edge
Patchwork bedcover with wadding sandwiched inside, stitched right through
Slotted opening in a wall that lets a stuffy room breathe out
The howling baby grunts and turns into one as Alice carries it outdoors
Gleeful snorting laugh coined in Jabberwocky, now a dictionary word
